briefing:
DATABRICKS PRE-CALL BRIEFING

Note: This is from my own knowledge, which has a cutoff date. Figures below may be out of date, so verify the latest numbers before quoting them on the call.

OVERVIEW
Databricks is a data and AI platform company headquartered in San Francisco, founded in 2013 by the creators of Apache Spark out of UC Berkeley. It popularized the "lakehouse" architecture, which combines data lake storage with data warehouse performance and governance. Customers include a large share of the Fortune 500 across financial services, retail, healthcare, and tech. The company is still private and has been widely expected to IPO, though timing has stayed open.

LEADERSHIP
Ali Ghodsi is co-founder and CEO. Other co-founders include Matei Zaharia (Spark creator, CTO), Reynold Xin, Ion Stoica, Patrick Wendell, and Andy Konwinski. Several co-founders remain active in product and research roles. Ghodsi is known for a customer-focused, open-source-friendly pitch.

FUNDING AND FINANCIALS
Databricks has raised well over $10 billion in total. A 2021 Series H valued it at $38 billion, and later rounds pushed the valuation above $60 billion, then reportedly past $100 billion in 2025. The company has reported annualized revenue run rate in the $3 billion-plus range, with growth above 50% year over year, and has said it is free cash flow positive. Treat these as approximate and check current reporting.

PRODUCTS
Core offerings include the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, Delta Lake (open table format), Unity Catalog (governance), Databricks SQL (warehousing), and Mosaic AI for building and deploying models and agents. Lakeflow handles data ingestion and pipelines. Key themes are open formats, unified governance, and generative AI on enterprise data. Main competitors are Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS, and Microsoft Fabric.

RECENT NEWS
The company acquired MosaicML (about $1.3 billion, 2023) and Tabular (2024, Apache Iceberg creators), and has made later AI-focused acquisitions. It launched DBRX, an open LLM, in 2024. Confirm any developments from the past several months before the call.
